words.gloss: those who do not show love (acc.)

literal: In reality, those who do not show love, they will blame - in dreams, the lover, those who do not see.
translation: Only those who do not see their lover in dreams will blame him for not showing love in reality.
modern: கனவில் தம் காதலரைக் காணாதவர்கள் மட்டுமே, நனவில் வந்து அன்பு செய்யாத அவரை நொந்துகொள்வார்கள்.
explanation: The heroine speaks of how dreams help her endure her lover's absence. She declares that only women who fail to see their lover in dreams will blame him for not showing love in the waking state. Since her dreams grant her the illusion of his presence and affection, she is spared from resenting his actual absence. The word 'நோவர்' (they will blame or suffer) emphasizes the bitterness of total separation, which she avoids through the comfort of her dreams.
